scope: Literature research of the 37 original source records (36 systems) within the approved 25 pc vicinity. Proposals are research findings, not catalog additions. Unknown types, tentative members and unresolved naming scopes remain explicit.

records.name: HD 79210
records.outcome: A/B already present; no additional physical star established.
authoringNotes: CARMENES classifies a double system. WDS AC/AD are optical, not additional physical components. Retain the legacy SB flag in provenance; it does not identify another star.

records.name: G 41-14
records.outcome: Triple: split A into Aa/Ab and add the resolved B.

records.name: Ross 775
records.outcome: Two stellar SB2 components; add B.
authoringNotes: Use the 53.221-day Ross 775/GJ 829 entry. Baroch Table D.1 also contains a conflicting 1.548-day eclipsing Ross 775 label; do not match by name alone.

records.name: BD-17 588A
records.outcome: Confirmed A + BC triple: add B and C.
authoringNotes: Preserve Winters A+BC nomenclature. CARMENES AB+C labels conflict with it. Gaia 5153091836072107008 represents an unresolved BC source; do not assign it as an exact individual C identity. Neither this Gaia ID nor two individual B/C rows are in the frozen full CNS5 input.

records.name: G 203-47
records.outcome: Add the white dwarf directly confirmed by HST spectroscopy in July 2026.
authoringNotes: Do not convert the old >0.5 solar-mass lower bound into a measured mass. Model temperature uses an assumed gravity.

records.name: G 202-45
records.outcome: Resolved low-mass stellar binary; add secondary.
authoringNotes: Martinache gives 0.371 +/-0.015 and 0.115 +/-0.0023 solar masses. The 2026 census compiles revised values; resolve the measurement lineage before physical-field adoption. WDS calls this Aa/Ab; A/B can follow the component paper with an explicit label note.

records.name: Xi UMa C
records.outcome: Already cataloged T8.5 member: associate with central Xi UMa; no duplicate object.
authoringNotes: CNS5 E and 2026 WDS D are alternative scopes. Keep the published Xi UMa C designation. Central component findings are on CNS5 2767.

records.name: Alula Australis
records.outcome: Central hierarchy Aa/Ab + Ba/Bb; Aa, Ab and Ba have supported stellar interpretations.

components.label: Ab
components.classificationBasis: 2026 census estimated M dwarf, 0.380 +/-0.038 solar masses

unresolvedComponents: Bb exists in a 3.98-day SB1 orbit, but its individual classification is uncertain. The 2026 M: assignment and 0.140 +/-0.090 solar-mass estimate overlap the substellar regime.
authoringNotes: Do not infer the one-epoch proposed extra Bc as a confirmed sixth member. Do not give all central components the combined ABCD physical values.

records.name: G 24-16
records.outcome: Resolved stellar pair; add B.
authoringNotes: Published mass/orbit determinations disagree; membership is supported but individual numerical masses need a reconciled source. CRC 37 is optical.

records.name: FL Aqr
records.outcome: FL Aqr is the B/D subsystem; D exists but its stellar versus brown-dwarf class is undetermined.
unresolvedComponents: D: SB1 minimum mass 61 +/-7 Jupiter masses does not establish a stellar or substellar class.
authoringNotes: A/C already authored in the previous expansion; no new classified D proposed.

records.name: BD-18 359
records.outcome: Resolved secondary supports an additional late-M star.

components.label: B
components.classificationBasis: Resolved photometry; 2026 estimated M6:V, mass 0.120 +/-0.020 solar masses

authoringNotes: Earlier photometry tentatively gave M7 and a lower boundary-crossing mass. The updated class and mass are photometric estimates, not individual spectroscopy or a component dynamical mass.

records.name: Wolf 227
records.outcome: Add the confirmed brown dwarf, not another ordinary star.

components.label: B
components.classificationBasis: Joint Gaia and RV dynamical mass

authoringNotes: Published final mass is 49.5 +4.3/-3.5 Jupiter masses. Preserve asymmetric errors in provenance. Historical CARMENES SB2 designation does not override the dedicated brown-dwarf study.

records.name: L 768-119
records.outcome: The SB1 companion is real; the 2026 census assigns an estimated M-dwarf interpretation.
unresolvedComponents: B lacks an independently detected component spectrum in the sources reviewed. Trace the 2024 mass estimate before authoring it as a secure typed object.
authoringNotes: The older roughly 60-Jupiter-mass minimum alone was insufficient. Do not treat the newer compiled estimate as a measured resolved mass.

records.name: G 184-19
records.outcome: A is an inner stellar SB2; add Ab alongside the existing wide B.
authoringNotes: Use Aa/Ab/B hierarchy rather than flattening the inner companion to the existing outer B.

records.name: G 237-78
records.outcome: Triple-lined stellar triple: add inner Ab and outer B.

records.name: G 100-28
records.outcome: Resolved low-mass stellar pair: add B.
authoringNotes: The 2026 orbit is weakly constrained. Do not turn its orbital period uncertainty into a precise rendered orbit.

records.name: RX J1214.1-2345
records.outcome: Source companion CNS5 3006 is tentative BD? with no individual spectrum.
unresolvedComponents: RX J1214.1-2345 B: Gaia DR3 3489874340630661248 has source astrometry but no secure stellar/substellar classification found.
authoringNotes: Searched both RX J1214.1-2345B and SCR J1214-2345B aliases and the Gaia ID. Do not convert BD? to a confirmed brown dwarf or ordinary star.

records.name: Delta Tri
records.outcome: Resolved and double-lined stellar binary: add B.
authoringNotes: Secondary spectral estimates differ between G9 and K4. Leave a precise individual spectral subtype blank rather than selecting one as certain.

records.name: HD 223778
records.outcome: Confirmed Aa/Ab stellar SB2 with a resolved outer M-dwarf B: add both.
authoringNotes: Raghavan Figure 22 distinguishes the 7.8-day inner pair from the approximately 290-year outer pair. Do not add optical WDS AC as another physical member.

records.name: HD 160346
records.outcome: Disentangled secondary spectrum now supports a stellar B.
authoringNotes: Secondary 3700 K is a selected template, without a robust temperature uncertainty. Inferred 0.39 +/-0.012 solar masses depends on estimated primary mass; it is not a dynamical individual mass.

records.name: MCC 188
records.outcome: Confirmed stellar SB2: add B.
authoringNotes: Baroch Table D.1 has period 10.319 days and q=0.94, identifying MCC 188 exactly. Do not use an unrelated short-period claim attached to its variable-star alias.

records.name: G 107-69
records.outcome: Associate the two confirmed white dwarfs in G 107-70 with G 107-69.
unresolvedComponents: G 107-69 B: astrometric companion is not individually typed; historical estimates straddle the dwarf/brown-dwarf boundary.
authoringNotes: Neither white dwarf Gaia ID occurs in the frozen full CNS5 source. Use their own published positions, not the M-dwarf position 103 arcsec away. CARMENES names the white dwarfs A/B and the M-dwarf pair C/D; retain subgroup names to avoid silently relabeling them.

records.name: Muphrid
records.outcome: Historical SB claim remains unconfirmed by direct component observations.
unresolvedComponents: Possible Ab: PTI/speckle non-detections allow a sufficiently faint companion, but do not establish its identity or type.
authoringNotes: Do not create an M7 star from the paper sensitivity limit.

records.name: HD 38A
records.outcome: Group the existing GJ 2 physical tertiary with HD 38 A/B.
unresolvedComponents: Proposed unresolved companions to A and possibly B lack individually established classifications.
authoringNotes: GJ 2 is WDS F and C in the 2025 table; use an explicit naming note. Its record already exists, so no new object is needed for this confirmed tertiary.

records.name: HD 75632A
records.outcome: Outer A/B already represented; the proposed inner third component is uncertain.
unresolvedComponents: Possible inner companion to A: authors declined to publish the tentative short orbit.
authoringNotes: The source explicitly describes possible, not confirmed, triplicity.

records.name: CD-28 302
records.outcome: Legacy SB flag does not yield a confirmed individual companion in this review.
unresolvedComponents: No typed individual B established. A null imaging observation does not rule out all close or faint companions.
authoringNotes: Retain the original flag, with the research outcome; do not label the star definitively single.

records.name: LP 756-19
records.outcome: A is a stellar SB2; add Ab alongside the existing wide B.
authoringNotes: Individual empirical masses and fitted temperatures are available in Baroch Tables 2/6, separate from the combined source spectrum.

reviewedMeasurements.method: empirical mass-luminosity relation and SB2 mass ratio

records.name: Deneb Algedi
records.outcome: Resolved red-dwarf secondary: add Ab.
authoringNotes: Primary radius 1.87 +/-0.02 solar radii is an individual measurement. Do not attach this radius to the secondary or add unrelated optical WDS B/C objects.

records.name: 85 Peg
records.outcome: Observed visual stellar pair supports adding B; its proposed inner Bb is not confirmed.
unresolvedComponents: Possible Bb remains a mass-luminosity/variability hypothesis, not a direct individual detection.
authoringNotes: Do not adopt the total dynamical B-subsystem mass as the physical mass of a hypothetical Ba or Bb.

records.name: HD 21531
records.outcome: RV source is SB1, but does not identify the companion class.
unresolvedComponents: Unseen companion: no sufficiently constrained individual type or mass established.

records.name: G 69-47
records.outcome: Stellar SB2: add B.

reviewedMeasurements.method: empirical mass-luminosity relation and SB2 mass ratio

records.name: G 236-34
records.outcome: Stellar SB2 identified as Karmn J10354+694: add B.

reviewedMeasurements.method: empirical mass-luminosity relation and SB2 mass ratio

records.name: Wolf 1473
records.outcome: Stellar SB2: add B.
authoringNotes: Do not mistake the measured M sin^3(i) values for true individual masses.

records.name: Ross 1057
records.outcome: Stellar SB2 with updated long-period orbit: add B.
authoringNotes: Use the 2021 orbit rather than the earlier approximate period. Orbit minimum masses are not actual masses.

records.name: BD+35 2436
records.outcome: A is a confirmed stellar SB2: add Ab; wide B is already present.
unresolvedComponents: The outer GJ 507 B also has an SB1 flag; its additional inner companion is not individually typed.
authoringNotes: CARMENES uses AB+Cab rather than conventional Aa/Ab/B. Keep a naming note. Optical HJ 529 and KZA 47 entries must not become physical members.

records.name: BD+39 2376A
records.outcome: Gaia-resolved M-dwarf companion is supported; an additional close object remains uncertain.

components.label: C
components.classificationBasis: Resolved co-moving M dwarf; B in 2025 table, HO 532 AC in WDS

unresolvedComponents: Possible separate CHR 191 AB companion: source warns of historical confusion with HO 532 AC; exact identity/membership needs reconciliation.
authoringNotes: Use Gaia ID as the secure identity. Resolve the B-versus-C label scope explicitly before card authoring; do not add both names as separate stars.

records.name: G 65-39
records.outcome: Stellar SB2: add B.

reviewedMeasurements.method: empirical mass-luminosity relation and SB2 mass ratio

fieldPolicy: Component spectra and physical values must describe individuals; combined source properties are not copied to children.
Empirical, photometric and model estimates retain their methods and uncertainties. Minimum masses and asymmetric errors are not silently converted to exact masses.
Unresolved close companions may share approximate source astrometry only with explicit provenance. Resolved wide companions use their own astrometry.
No instantaneous component radial velocity is adopted as a barycentric trajectory, and no uncorrected white-dwarf spectroscopic RV is adopted.
